name: Sign-in methods follow capabilities and password controls remain usable

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/sign-in in a fresh unauthenticated browser context. Do not send a code, submit credentials, pair a device or start Google login.
The heading is Your day, with Muster. and the Create an account link points to /sign-up with the preserved destination query.

After /api/auth-capabilities settles, Continue with Google is visible only when Google is configured or desktopOAuth is offered; otherwise it is absent. If capability loading fails, the page shows the sign-in methods notice and Check again button.

When emailOtp is true, Email address for a sign-in code and Email me a code are visible, and the password form is initially collapsed behind Use a password instead. When emailOtp is false, the password form is already expanded.
If Use a password instead is present, expand it. Fill the password email field with not-an-email and the password field with a synthetic 16-character string, then click Sign in with email.

Browser email validation rejects the malformed address, focus remains on the invalid email field, no sign-in request is sent, and the page remains unauthenticated. Do not submit a well-formed address or real password.
